ACCOMMODATION
Tailored versus lavish. More than spacious—immersive. An intimate interior, which easily
accommodates the most varied of lifestyles, always conforms, and never constrains.
INVITE EVERYONE With comfortable seating
for up to 8 adult passengers1, you’ll never have
to leave anyone behind. The Infiniti QX80 also
makes ingress and egress easy with wide door
openings, and a second row that folds with the
push of a button1. Third-row passengers will be
able to enter with ease.
SPACE THAT EMPOWERS The QX80 offers a
maximum cargo space of 95.1 cubic feet.7 But
that space is carefully designed to be eminently
useful to you, even in your everyday excursions.
There are a multitude of storage areas placed
conveniently through the cabin. Also, the large
rear gate opens to a flat cargo area—even with
the third row folded down—that is free from
encumbrance and makes loading and unloading
simple and easy.
PREMIUM SECOND ROW There is no coach class
in an Infiniti QX80. The seats in the second row
conform to the same exceptional standards as
the front seats. Leather-appointed, spacious
captain’s chairs support passengers in total
comfort even on long journeys1. Those in the
second row also enjoy heated seats, their
own customizable climate control zone, and a
spacious wood-trimmed center console.
TOTALLY FLEXIBLE Living a varied and outgoing
lifestyle means carrying a wide variety of cargo items
INTERIOR VOLUME and passengers, often at the same time. The interior
seating of the QX80 transforms quickly and easily to
152.5 16.6 49.6 accommodate just about anything you need to bring.
The third row folds flat with the push of a button and

splits 60/40, allowing you carry large items even with

passengers still in the back. The seats in the second
row also tip forward, opening up that much more
